If the report includes a real secret, real recovery share, passphrase, exploit details that should stay private, or recovered secret output, do not post it in a public issue.

This template creates a public issue. Use it only for non-sensitive questions. Even a short vulnerability summary can disclose exploit details; do not post those details here. A private reporting channel has not been verified for this repository. Keep sensitive reports private until a maintainer provides a verified channel.
